status: Candidate17 remapped binary verified in isolated native tests; live host acceptance pending
scope: Exact ordered static-instance differences and validated cache-only scene initialization; original skating physics, animation and grind predicates unchanged

compiled_source_hash_algorithm.selection: Every SOURCE-PROVENANCE.json files entry whose relative POSIX path ends .rs or has basename Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock
compiled_source_hash_algorithm.records: Objects containing only path and lowercase sha256, sorted lexicographically by path
compiled_source_hash_algorithm.encoding: UTF-8 of Python json.dumps(records, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True)

checks.fixture_changes: Same-package movement, insertion, deletion, duplicate records and reordering; complete fresh-bake eligible lip records match incremental delta

identity_rules: Every surviving static record must keep exact mesh bytes, transform bits, package, provenance and occurrence position.
Relative reordering of matching records retains the conservative existing package invalidation.
Terrain comes from the exact same validated immutable base.
Required-cache initialization rejects missing/corrupt/mismatched scene caches before creating a Session, and never rebakes an old seed.
The caller validates save/base/worker identity and must install the fresh captured collision before exposing readiness.
limits: Moving objects remain in collision; changes are not ignored or frozen.
Original complete rail merge/index rebuilding remains for a changed scene.
Original HashMap rail representative selection can differ between uncached merges; persistence keeps the first exact stored ordered result.
No game input or live installed replacement was used by these native checks.
Private snapshots and owned game assets are not included.
